game.desc: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm Revolution is a fighting game for Xbox 360. Adapted from Masashi Kishimoto's manga and the DA produced by Pierrot Studios, the game features a hundred people, for very dynamic confrontations extremely faithful to the original work.
